results.question: Use the Linen Shirt then, all colours.
results.sql: SELECT to_char(o.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney', 'YYYY-MM') AS month, sum(l.quantity) AS units_sold, round(sum(l.unit_price * l.quantity - l.line_discount), 2) AS gross_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_lines l USING (order_id) JOIN variants v USING (variant_id) JOIN products p USING (product_id) WHERE o.financial_status <> 'voided' AND p.title = 'Linen Shirt' AND o.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney' >= '2026-07-01'::date AND o.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney' < '2026-10-01'::date GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
results.assumptions: Interpreting as: How have sales of the Linen Shirt (all colours) changed over the last 3 months? Date range is July, August, and September 2026 (the last 3 months of the dataset, treating 2026-09-30 as today). Revenue is gross line revenue (after line discounts).
results.answer: Sales of the Linen Shirt across all colours increased in August before dropping back down in September, with July seeing 25 units sold for $2,418.79 in gross revenue, August reaching 33 units for $3,278.35, and September finishing at 24 units for $2,338.84. These figures reflect gross line revenue after line discounts for July, August, and September 2026.
